name: Town Canteen
signature_dish: Benne (butter) masala dosa with filter coffee
why_it_matters: Ranked #1 of 58 restaurants in Chikmagalur on Tripadvisor and the town's single most-cited eatery — a 60-plus-year institution that started in the 1960s cooking under a tree before shifting to its current Rathnagiri Road premises near the Government Polytechnic. The crisp, buttery benne masala dosa is what every food blog and motorcycle-tourer write-up sends visitors here for.
insider_tip: Go for breakfast 7.30-9.30am for the freshest dosa batch — it is a fixed tiffin menu (dosa, idli-vada, upma, kesari bath, puliyogare), no a-la-carte. Chase the dosa with the cardamom-syrup gulab jamun and the house-blend filter coffee. No dedicated parking, so come on two wheels or park up the road. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Town Canteen, Opposite Government Polytechnic, Rathnagiri Road, Chikmagalur, Karnataka 577101

name: Soundarya Restaurant
signature_dish: Pure-veg South Indian meals and tiffin
why_it_matters: The pure-veg restaurant attached to Soundarya Residency on Indira Gandhi Road, directly opposite the KSRTC bus stand — the convenient, no-frills veg meals-and-tiffin stop for travellers arriving by bus. Cabin-style booth seating gives a bit of privacy and there is roadside parking for two- and four-wheelers.
insider_tip: Being opposite the bus stand it is busy at meal times; the booth cabins at the back are quieter. South and North Indian on one menu — stick to the South Indian tiffin and meals, which are the consistent picks. Cash and UPI; lodge upstairs if you need a room.
signature_address: Soundarya Restaurant, Soundarya Residency, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite KSRTC Bus Stand, Jyothinagar, Chikmagalur, Karnataka 577101

name: Vishnu Delicacy
why_it_matters: A small, cosy pure-veg multi-cuisine restaurant on Indira Gandhi Road near the Bank of Baroda branch, a short walk from the KSRTC bus stand — a reliable family veg option for visitors who skip the Malnad-chicken kitchens. South Indian, North Indian and Chinese on one menu.
insider_tip: Compact room, so it fills fast at lunch — go before 1pm or after 2.30pm. The South Indian tiffin is the safest order; the Chinese is the standard Indo-Chinese gobi/paneer manchurian style. Cash and UPI accepted.
signature_address: Vishnu Delicacy, Indira Gandhi Road, near Bank of Baroda, Jyothinagar, Chikmagalur, Karnataka 577101

name: Maharaja Restaurant
why_it_matters: Chikmagalur's go-to non-veg address — ranked #6 of 46 restaurants on Tripadvisor and the name locals give visitors who want a proper Muslim-style mutton biryani in a town dominated by pure-veg meals houses. Mutton chukka, tandoori chicken and kebabs round out the menu.
insider_tip: The mutton biryani sells out — get there for lunch or call ahead, as reviewers report 45-minute waits and the biryani gone by mid-afternoon on weekends. It is genuinely meat-focused; vegetarians are better served at the veg houses nearby. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: Maharaja Restaurant, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite Giri Inn, Chikmagalur, Karnataka 577101

name: The Estate Cafe
area: Chinnenahalli A Estate, Mallandur, Chikmagalur District
why_it_matters: A purpose-built cafe set inside a 140-year-old working coffee plantation at Mallandur, roughly a 25-minute drive (about 19 km) from Chikmagalur town on the road towards Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary and Muthodi forest. The coffee is estate-grown and roasted on the same certified property — one of the oldest plantations in Karnataka.
insider_tip: It is an out-of-town stop, not a town cafe — pair it with a Mullayanagiri or Bhadra-side drive. Covered and open-air seating with valley views; quietest mid-morning on weekdays. The estate also runs coffee and spice plantation walks December to March. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: The Estate Cafe, Chinnenahalli A Estate, Mallandur Post, Chikmagalur District, Karnataka 577101

name: Farm Cafe
why_it_matters: A vegetarian cafe on the road toward Kemmanagundi, rated 4.6 on Tripadvisor — a clean, hygienic lunch stop for travellers heading to the Kemmanagundi hill station, with food cooked from the farm's own home-grown vegetables and paneer.
insider_tip: It sits on the Kemmanagundi route, so use it as a lunch break en route rather than a town meal. Hot, fresh, simple veg food; portions are home-style. Cash and UPI; carry small notes for the drive.
signature_address: Farm Cafe, Kemmanagundi Road, Chikmagalur, Karnataka 577101
